RENT IT FURNISHED REALTY

This sun-filled 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom and den located in Kitsilano, Vancouver furnished condo rental has Hardwood floors, stylish, high-end Luxury furnishings from INspiration Furniture store, including Natuzzi white leather Couch and accent chair. You will appreciate ample natural light in the den or watch Netflix or cable TV sitting on the comfy couch next to the gas fireplace in the comfort of the living room or dining at the glass dining table. The kitchen features a generous layout with Quartz counter tops, stainless steel appliances and tile flooring for easy cleaning. The den has a at home office which can be fully closed off for privacy, and includes a large working desk.

This apartment/condo home located at 3333 4th Avenue W, Vancouver is currently for rent and has been available on Zolo.ca for 33 days. It has 2 beds, 2 bathrooms, and is 940 square feet. 3333 4th Avenue W, Vancouver is in the Kitsilano neighborhood Vancouver. Fairview VW, Arbutus and Point Grey are nearby neighborhoods.

About 204 - 3333 4th Avenue W, Vancouver

Want to compare this condo to other suites in the building? Take a look at the other available 3333 West 4th Avenue apartment for sale. Right now, there are 389 condos for rent (Vancouver).

This real estate is located at 3333 West 4th Avenue, Vancouver, British Columbia and is found in the community of Kitsilano in Vancouver. Other neighbourhoods nearby are Fairview Vw, Arbutus and Point Grey. 4th Avenue has 11 properties currently available, while the area of Kitsilano has 187 postings available. That's just 4.18% of the 4,470 total properties for sale in the city of Vancouver. The average asking price of a home in Kitsilano is $1,981,472, with an estimated mortgage of $7,232 per month.* That is 33% higher than the average list price of $1,493,262 found across all Vancouver homes for sale. The average Kitsilano listed property is 1,500 sq ft, has 3 beds, and 2 baths. Apartments make up less than one quarter of properties for sale in the community around 3333 West 4th Avenue.

* Monthly payments are an estimate based on a mortgage with 20% down @ 2.65% with a 5-yr Variable rate
